sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r13/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 30 (check 29) and Internal Quality Checks row 30; Deterministic Checks C28
evidence: Real gates: tests/scoring.toml has [gates] render = 0.0, constraints = 0.0; score.py:41-48 zeroes the reward unless every gate passes. gates/render/judge.toml:18-23 cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing (all_pass, binary): 'Fails if the page is blank or shows only an error, if no code editing area is shown, if the typed word does not appear in the editor, or if the workspace does not load again after the reload'; gates/render/prompt.md:5 'A blank page, a generic error, an unavailable server, or a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into fails.' Backing leg (app has no sign-in, app_context.md:10 'None'): gates/constraints/judge.toml:51-56 cw_shared_saved_record saves through the UI as a positive control, clears origin browser storage, reloads twice and re-reads title, filename and source, so a browser-only shell fails; public basis integration.md:7 'Saved snippets ... must survive page reloads' and 'shared between independent browser contexts'. cw_custom_document_surface has its public basis in ui.md:3 and policy.md:3. In-dimension gates: scored/functional/prompt.md:5, scored/polish/prompt.md:5 and scored/visual/prompt.md:5 all carry the identical line 'Global browser gate: before scoring, confirm in the live browser that the application loads from http://localhost:3000 without a fatal browser error and that text typed into the code editor appears in it. External font, script or CDN asset requests are allowed. If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension.' - a hard zero, no partial credit; visual line 7 keeps 0 reachable ('Apart from a failed global browser gate, 0 is used only when ...'). Same-origin: grep of task/tests for same-origin/cross-origin returns nothing; all five prompts and app_context.md:31 explicitly allow external font, script or CDN requests; task.toml network_mode = "public" (lines 22, 38). Weak app tried: static HTML with a fake editor that ignores keys fails the render gate and all three scored gates; a client-only localStorage playground with a working editor passes render but fails cw_shared_saved_record. Conforming alternative tried: canvas-drawn editor loading fonts from a CDN, with an unsaved-draft confirmation on reload, passes (app_context.md:22 and :28 cover both). Notes, not defects: (1) the scored in-dimension gate has no server-backing leg; backing is carried only by the constraints gate, which matches the frozen template (its scored gates carry only the sign-in leg) and the scored suite is skipped when a gate fails; (2) functional and polish prompts omit the template sentence 'The global browser gate is the only all-or-nothing rule in this dimension', though their gate line is explicit. Evidence verified: sha256 of results/runtime.json, polish.json, persist-before.json, editor.json, persist-after.json, restart.json, run_golden.sh and tests/smoke.cjs match the raw-evidence index; the scripted golden passes cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing, cw_custom_document_surface and cw_shared_saved_record. Risk stays true: no configured judge run exists on these bytes; the render gate was reduced to load-and-type after the only hosted run (earlier candidate ZIP eda58464), so the judge's reading of the current gate criteria and of the three in-dimension gates is unmeasured.
